meta.title: Savora
meta.description: A bilingual QR menu for your café or restaurant.

design.title: Savora design system
design.lead: The tokens and components every screen is built from, in light and dark, English and Arabic.
design.emailError: Enter an email address like name@place.com.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.panelBody: A little less paper. A lot more room to serve.
auth.lead: Sign in to manage your menus, QR codes and scans.
auth.invalidEmail: Enter an email address like name@place.com.
auth.tooMany: Too many links requested. Try again in a few minutes.
auth.failed: We couldn't send the link. Check your connection and try again.
auth.googleFailed: Google sign-in didn't finish. Try again or use your email.
auth.checkBody: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. It works once and expires in 15 minutes.
auth.terms: By continuing you agree to Savora's Terms and Privacy Policy.
auth.expiredBody: Sign-in links work once and expire after 15 minutes. Ask for a new one.

welcome.title: Set up your place
welcome.lead: Name your business and its first location. You can add more locations later.

overview.lead: A clear view of your brands, locations, and the next place to put your attention.
overview.glanceBody: Choose a location to jump straight into its menu.
overview.stepProfileDone: Your name and public link are set
overview.stepMenuBody: Upload a photo of your menu or type it in
overview.stepShareBody: Print your QR code for every table
overview.identityEmpty: Your dishes appear here once you add them.

soon.body: This screen is built in Phase {n} of the roadmap.

editor.title: Bring your menu to life.
editor.lead: Start with what you already have. We'll make it ready for every guest, in both languages.
editor.noLocation: Add a location first to build its menu.
editor.studioTitle: The first draft is the easiest one.
editor.studioBody: Upload a menu photo or PDF, paste what you have, or start with a clean page. Savora keeps the structure tidy while you make it yours.
editor.reviewNote: Review every item before it reaches your live menu.
editor.pastePlaceholder:
Paste your menu here…
Cardamom Latte / لاتيه بالهيل 18
editor.blankBody: Build one beautiful item at a time.
editor.previewBody: Your colors and layout evolve as your menu grows.
editor.publishBody: Your draft can keep changing without touching the QR menu until you publish it.
editor.published: Version {n} is live. Guests see it on their next scan.
editor.emptyMenu: Add at least one item guests can see before publishing.
editor.healthBody: A quick pass over your draft before it becomes the public menu.
editor.checkItemsBad: Add at least one item guests can see.
editor.emptyBody: Paste your menu above, or add your first item.
editor.photoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP up to 8 MB. Lists show a square crop.
editor.photoFailed: That file isn't a photo we can use. Try a JPG or PNG.
editor.availableHint: Turn off when it's sold out. It stays in your draft.
editor.nameRequired: Add a name in English or Arabic.
editor.failed: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.
editor.deleteBody: It leaves your draft now. Guests keep seeing it until you publish.
editor.categoriesBody: Rename, reorder or remove the sections of your menu. Changes reach guests when you publish.
editor.reviewBody: Savora found these in your text. They go into your draft, not the live menu.
editor.reviewNothing: We couldn't find any prices. Put each item on its own line with its price at the end, like: Cardamom Latte 18

guest.title: {name} · Menu
guest.description: The menu at {name}, in English and Arabic.
guest.soonBody: Check back soon. The menu will appear at this same link, so keep the code handy.
guest.missingBody: Check the link, or scan the code at your table again.
guest.pausedTitle: {name}'s menu is taking a short break
guest.pausedBody: It will be back at this same link soon.

qr.title: Your permanent QR code
qr.lead: Print this once. It stays the same even when you change your entire menu.
qr.live: Live · points to your current menu
qr.notLive: Not published yet · guests see a "coming soon" page
qr.previewAlt: {format} for {name}, with a QR code that opens {url}
qr.downloadSvg: QR as SVG for print shops
qr.instagramCopied: Link copied. Paste it into your Instagram bio or a story link sticker.
qr.reason1Title: A visual signature for your place
qr.reason1Body: Your name and colors give every printed code a recognizable home.
qr.reason2Body: Download one branded PNG for tables, windows, or takeaway bags.
qr.reason3Body: Change prices and items without replacing the printed sign.

analytics.title: Scan analytics
analytics.lead: See when and how often guests open your menu.
analytics.heroNoteToday: scans so far · about {n} an hour
analytics.todayAbove: +{pct}% vs a typical day by now
analytics.todayBelow: {pct}% vs a typical day by now
analytics.todayNoBaseline: Not enough history to compare yet
analytics.allTimeNote: scans since your menu went live
analytics.busiestDayBody: {count} this week. Keep your {day} favourites up to date.
analytics.busiestWeekdayTitle: {day} is your busiest day of the week
analytics.peakHourBody: {count} in that hour, more than any other today.
analytics.weekendBody: Friday and Saturday together, out of the whole week.
analytics.todayBody: {count} so far, against about {typical} by this time on a typical day.
analytics.qrBody: The rest opened a shared link, from Instagram, WhatsApp or a friend.
analytics.languageBody: Guests switch freely, so keep both languages complete.
analytics.quietBody: Insights appear once guests start scanning.
analytics.emptyBody: Place your QR code on tables, the counter or the window. Scans appear here within seconds.
analytics.notLiveTitle: Your menu is not live yet
analytics.notLiveBody: Publish your menu and scans start counting from the first guest.
analytics.privacy: Counted without cookies or stored IP addresses. Visits from your own team are not counted.

settings.title: Location settings
settings.lead: Everything guests see about this branch: where it is, when it's open, and how it looks when they scan.
settings.saved: Saved. Guests see the changes on their next scan.
settings.failed: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.
settings.readOnly: You can view these settings. Only owners and admins can change them.
settings.idBody: Shown at the top of the menu, in both languages.
settings.linkLocked: Locked so printed QR codes keep working.
settings.mapBody: Drag the pin to your front door. It powers the Directions button and the map on your menu.
settings.noResults: No places found. Try a street and a city.
settings.geocoderDown: Search is unavailable right now. Drag the pin instead.
settings.pinHint: Drag the pin or click the map
settings.noPin: No pin yet: click the map where your door is.
settings.mapLabel: Map of {name}. Use the search box, or click the map to move the pin.
settings.radiusOff: Turn on Delivery zone to set how far you deliver.
settings.radiusHint: About {min} min by scooter. Guests outside the ring see pickup only.
settings.showMapHint: A small map card with your address and a one-tap Directions button.
settings.hoursBody: Guests see “Open now” or when you open next.
settings.noHours: No hours yet, so guests see no open or closed status.
settings.timezoneHint: Used for “Open now” and your daily scan charts.
settings.brandBody: Your logo and cover photo appear at the top of the guest menu.
settings.logoHint: Square PNG or JPG, at least 512 px. Shared by every {brand} branch.
settings.coverHint: A wide photo of the room or the counter. This branch only.
settings.photoFailed: That file isn't a photo we can use. Try a JPG or PNG.
settings.themesBody: Colours and the look of the guest menu live in Menu themes.
settings.actionsBody: Each filled link becomes a button at the top of your menu. Empty ones stay hidden.
settings.urlInvalid: Enter a full link starting with https://

healthLeft.one: {n} quick win left to a complete listing.
healthLeft.other: {n} quick wins left to a complete listing.

billing.title: Choose the right level for your place
billing.lead: Your menu stays live and your QR link stays the same, whichever plan you're on.
billing.noCharge: No monthly charge · billed in USD
billing.pastDue: Payment was due {date}. Your plan stays on until {grace}.
billing.compareBody: Start with the essentials, then move up when your menu or locations need more.
billing.descStarter: The essentials for one location and one live menu.
billing.descGrowth: Imports, analytics, and more control for a busy location.
billing.descMulti: A shared workspace for growing restaurant groups.
billing.growthLimit: For 1 to 3 locations · {total} a month for you
billing.promise1Body: Printed codes keep working on every plan.
billing.promise2Title: Nothing is lost when you switch
billing.promise2Body: Menus and revisions stay exactly where they are.
billing.promise3Body: Guests still see prices in your own currency.
billing.pendingTitle: Your {plan} upgrade is waiting for payment
billing.pendingBody: Pay {amount} by bank transfer or in cash and quote the reference. Your plan switches on as soon as the payment is confirmed, usually within one working day.
billing.noBankYet: Our team will contact you with payment details.
billing.declinedNoNote: Your last request was declined. Contact us if you think this is a mistake.
billing.howBody: For now Savora takes payment by bank transfer or cash. Send your request, pay with the reference you get, and the plan switches on once the payment is confirmed.
billing.failed: Couldn't send. Check your connection and try again.
billing.down1: Scan analytics and imports lock. Scans keep counting.
billing.down2: Order and booking buttons are hidden from guests.
billing.downPaused: These locations pause for guests until you upgrade: {names}.
billing.downConfirm: Switch at the end of the month
billing.endsBanner: Your plan moves to Starter on {date}.
billing.pausedBody: Your plan covers {max}. Upgrade to bring them back; nothing was deleted.
billing.ownerOnly: Only the owner can change the plan.

locks.analyticsBody: Your scans are already being counted: {n} so far. Upgrade to see when guests come, your busiest days and where they come from.
locks.analyticsBodyZero: Scans are counted from the first guest on every plan. Upgrade to see when guests come, your busiest days and where they come from.
locks.guestLinks: Order and booking buttons come with Growth.

locations.title: Add a location
locations.body: A new branch gets its own menu, QR code and link. It starts with this group’s currency and time zone.
locations.failed: Couldn't add the location. Try again.
locations.limitBody: Upgrade to {plan} to add another branch.
locations.limitTop: You have reached the largest plan’s limit. Contact us for more locations.

staff.title: Payments to confirm
staff.lead: Match each transfer by its reference, then activate the plan. Owners see the result straight away.
